{{recipe}}

A quick, easy bread that works well with Italian foods and pastas. Try forming the dough into a round ball or a long loaf for French Bread.

==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] warm water (110°F / 45°C)
* 2 ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] active dry [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white granulated sugar]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 ½ cups all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

==Procedure==
# In a large bowl mix together the warm water, yeast, sugar, salt, and olive oil.
# Stir in 2 cups of the flour in order to make a soft ball. 
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] in additional flour so that dough is soft and not sticky. 
# Place kneaded dough in a medium size greased bowl. Cover and let rise until doubled in size.
# Punch down dough, and form into ball or loaf shape. 
# Place onto a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]]. Cover and let rise for 15–20 minutes. 
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 375° F (190°C).
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the preheated oven for 30–40 minutes, until golden brown.
# For a glazed, shiny effect, brush one egg white and one tablespoon of water (mixed) onto the bread 5 minutes before completion.
